description:
READ-ONLY. When the user has NO server yet, START HERE. FIRST ask the user which VPS
    provider they use, and pass it as `provider`. Maps the workload (the plan's edition + app
    set, plus an optional expected_users) to a recommended VPS size for that provider: the size
    class, the concrete instance type + specs, a ROUGH monthly cost, and the derived Odoo worker
    count. It also returns `ask_the_user` - the questions the agent must still ask (region/zone,
    server name, edition confirm, expected users, ssh key) before calling cloud_provision. No
    network, no secret needed. Next: cloud_provision(plan, provider, region, size, …).

    Just pass the provider the user tells you. If the built-in shortcut can't handle it, the tool
    says so - then there are TWO paths, YOUR call with the user: (a) they create a small Ubuntu/
    Debian box themselves and you host_enroll it (works on ANY provider), or (b) they give you a
    scoped provider API key and YOU create the box via that provider's own API using your own
    knowledge, then base_provision it. DO NOT list or advertise which providers are auto-createable
    - never imply the product is limited to a set of providers.
name: cloud_recommend
